title: DevOps Engineer (with Python)
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with strong Python skills to support a team focused on improving customer operations through technology and data insights.

In this role, you will work closely with an external vendor building AI-assisted evaluation workflows that analyze customer interactions. Your primary focus will be on designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.

You will also contribute to backend services where needed, using Python to support data access, automation, and system integrations.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.

You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the vendor and internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations)

● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)

● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)

● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling

● Good Python skills for scripting, automation, and backend support

● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

● Strong communication and coordination skills



Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.js

● Exposure to AI-driven workflows or data platforms


This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working across development and infrastructure, enabling data-driven systems, and collaborating across teams to deliver impactful solutions.


Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

title: Senior Data Engineer with AWS (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Experience working with public cloud platforms, especially AWS;
  • Ability to code in at least one programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, Scala) is a must;
  • Experience using a querying language such as SQL;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • B2 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: AI Data Engineer - 131496
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com (Dados/IA).

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica na construção de soluções agentic unindo engenharia de dados em Azure e Copilot Studio;
  • Projetar e desenvolver pipelines de dados em Azure Data Factory e/ou Databricks, preparando bases confiáveis para consumo por agentes de IA;
  • Construir e evoluir agentes no Copilot Studio, incluindo tópicos, ações, fluxos, conectores e integrações com sistemas corporativos;
  • Implementar padrões de RAG: curadoria de fontes, chunking, embeddings, estratégias de busca e governança do conteúdo utilizado pelos agentes;
  • Integrar agentes a dados corporativos via APIs, conectores e camadas analíticas (Lakehouse, SQL, semantic models), garantindo rastreabilidade de respostas;
  • Definir e supervisionar padrões de observabilidade: logs, telemetria, métricas de uso, qualidade de resposta e monitoramento de falhas ponta a ponta;
  • Atuar com segurança e governança: controle de acesso, proteção de dados sensíveis, auditoria e conformidade com LGPD;
  • Apoiar o time em design reviews, troubleshooting de pipelines e agentes, otimização de performance e resolução de incidentes complexos.

Requisitos :

  • Formação e experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em Azure;
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio (criação de copilots, tópicos, actions, conectores, publicação e gestão de ambientes);
  • Experiência com pipelines em Azure Data Factory e/ou Databricks;
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para transformação e automação;
  • Conhecimento prático de RAG, embeddings, vetorização e estratégias de recuperação de informação;
  • Experiência com integrações via REST APIs e conectores corporativos;
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança (RBAC, Key Vault, identities) e práticas de auditoria/compliance;
  • Vivência com Git e CI/CD para versionamento e promoção entre ambientes.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Model);
  • Vivência com Azure AI Foundry e/ou Azure OpenAI para orquestração e avaliação de modelos;
  • Experiência com Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) e conectores avançados;
  • Implementação de guardrails: content filters, políticas, grounding, fallback e segurança de prompts
  • Observabilidade e avaliação de agentes: testes, métricas de qualidade, feedback loop e melhoria contínua;
  • Certificações Azure (DP-203, AI-102, PL-600/PL-700) e/ou Microsoft Applied Skills.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (Motion) with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion.


You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentation and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.



What you’ll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements - including transitions, text animations, graphics packages and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.



What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.



Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility - powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation - we’d love to hear from you.



Benefits

  • USD-based compensation
  • Work from anywhere

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Business Analyst | Data Governance
description:
Cód. 58557


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei BA, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência em Governança de Dados, Análise de Processos ou Engenharia de Requisitos , preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte.

• Vivência com ferramentas de catálogo e gestão de dados (ex.: DataPlex, OpenMetadata ou similares).

• Conhecimento em Metadados, Qualidade de Dados, Data Stewardship e MDM .

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de demandas como ServiceNow ou similares .

• Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e Power BI para acompanhamento de métricas e indicadores.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Supervisor de Contas Médicas - Oncologia
description:
Requisitos:


- Superior completo.

-Excel intermediário;

-Necessário boa vivência com faturamento, auditoria de contas, conhecimento com contratos e aditivos assinados com os convênios, fechamento e análise de contas e operação de sistemas.




Atividades:


-Solicitar ao moto boy e/ou auxiliar administrativo que peguem as guias nas unidades e hospitais quando necessário;

-Receber e controlar diariamente as guias de atendimentos das unidades e hospitais;

- Mensurar o recebimento em planilha e enviar para os envolvidos no processo, sinalizando as pendências, quando for o caso;

-Distribuir a demanda das guias entre os funcionários, garantindo o equilíbrio;

-Definir a demanda do faturista curinga, observando a necessidade diária do setor;

-Cobrar as pendências não entregues, garantindo o envio dentro do cronograma do convênio e no menor tempo possível;

-Mensurar a produção diária e as guias não faturadas em planilha e enviar aos envolvidos;

- Analisar as contas fechadas pelos faturistas com o objetivo de verificar a exatidão das cobranças, orientando-os sempre que necessário;

-Sinalizar para as áreas as inconsistências encontradas nas contas com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho de completude;

-Sugerir e/ou apoiar as áreas na solução dos problemas identificados;

-Mensurar em planilha as inconsistências encontradas nas contas e enviar mensalmente a Gerência;

-Fechar contas de consulta e procedimentos;

-Realizar o processo de auditoria de contas com os convênios que fazem pré-análise, sinalizando a Gerência sempre que houver glosas indevidas;

-Realizar contato com médicos, enfermagem, recepção, pacientes e convênios sobre os processos de faturamento e etc.




Outras informações:


- Local de trabalho: ASA SUL - Brasilia(DF);

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - Seg à Sex (08h às 18h) / Sex - 08h às 17h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Coordenador de Order To Cash
description:
Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time . O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas , com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe , promovendo autonomia e direcionamento.
  • Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário.
  • Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash , incluindo:
  • Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes).
  • Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento.
  • Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário).
  • Configuração de formas de pagamento no SAP.
  • Conciliação bancária, baixa de recebíveis e títulos.
  • Cálculo de PDD e análise da saúde do contas a receber.
  • Apoiar atividades fiscais e contábeis relacionadas ao processo OTC.
  • Propor e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores para gestão da área.
  • Garantir comunicação eficaz com áreas internas (ex.: força de vendas) e clientes.
  • Participar do fechamento contábil mensal.


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Excel avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação).
  • Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Power BI / Power Query (não prioritário).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação).


Competências Comportamentais


  • Perfil autônomo , organizado e proativo.
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado .
  • Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:

Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;

  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;

  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;

  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Desenvolvimento ServiceNow
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento ServiceNow


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de ServiceNow, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em automação de processos, transformação digital e melhoria da experiência do usuário.


Se você busca trabalhar com uma plataforma líder em workflows e gestão de serviços, criando soluções escaláveis e integradas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui


  • Desenvolver e customizar soluções na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Criar workflows, automações e aplicações utilizando o ServiceNow;
  • Atuar com desenvolvimento de scripts (server-side e client-side);
  • Trabalhar com criação e customização de módulos, formulários e catálogos de serviços;
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com outros sistemas e APIs;
  • Atuar em diferentes módulos (ITSM, ITOM, HR, CSM, entre outros);
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, governança e performance;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (negócio, produto, engenharia);
  • Participar de code reviews e melhoria contínua das soluções.


O que buscamos


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e/ou configuração na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (base da plataforma);
  • Experiência com criação de workflows, business rules, client scripts e UI policies;
  • Familiaridade com módulos como ITSM, ITOM, CSM ou similares;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST/SOAP;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados dentro da plataforma;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com práticas de ITIL é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e DevOps para ServiceNow é um diferencial;
  • Certificações ServiceNow serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos


  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Colaboração e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono;
  • Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas;
  • Interesse por inovação e evolução contínua na plataforma;

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence.


From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


The Newfold family of brands includes: Bluehost , Web.com, Register.com, HostGator and Domain.com, among others.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

title: Growth Business Development (Fresh Graduates | Brazil)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential KOLs
  • Support KOL and design special campaigns to increase KOL trading volume
  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients


Requirements


  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Azure Data Engineer (remote)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Data Engineer com foco em Azure para atuar em um time internacional e multicultural , colaborando com profissionais de diferentes países em projetos globais de dados. Trata-se de uma oportunidade em uma grande consultoria global de tecnologia , reconhecida por atuar em projetos complexos de transformação digital para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo.

A posição é 100% remota , com contratação no modelo PJ , e exige inglês avançado , já que a comunicação diária acontece com times e stakeholders internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Criar e manter soluções de armazenamento de dados utilizando Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake e Azure Blob Storage
  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados para ingestão, processamento e transformação em ambientes Azure
  • Desenvolver modelos de dados voltados para analytics
  • Criar e manter processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) utilizando Azure Data Factory ou tecnologias similares
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory e Databricks para construção e processamento de grandes volumes de dados
  • Implementar processos de validação e limpeza de dados , garantindo qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade das informações
  • Garantir segurança e compliance dos dados
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, times técnicos e stakeholders de negócio para entender requisitos e transformá-los em arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps
  • Conhecimento em Apache Spark e Python
  • Forte domínio de SQL
  • Experiência com Azure Databricks
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de Big Data
  • Experiência com ingestão de dados em Azure
  • Programação em PySpark, Python e SQL


Perfil buscado

  • Forte base técnica em engenharia de dados
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas
  • Boa comunicação para interação em times internacionais
  • Experiência colaborando com times multidisciplinares

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Contractor / PJ)

Duration: 12 months (with potential extension)


Overview :

Our client is seeking a Senior Recruiter to support US-based clients in a fast-paced staffing environment. This role requires strong English communication, experience working directly with US stakeholders, and the ability to manage high-volume recruiting across multiple requisitions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage full lifecycle recruiting (intake → sourcing → screening → submission → interview → offer → close)
  • Support US-based hiring managers and account teams
  • Handle high-volume req loads (20–40+ open roles depending on complexity)
  • Recruit across technical and/or professional roles
  • Work within ATS/VMS systems (including high-touch / low-touch / no-touch environments)
  • Maintain strong pipeline activity and candidate engagement
  • Ensure high-quality submissions with strong attention to detail


Requirements:

  • 5+ years recruiting experience (agency or staffing strongly preferred)
  • Track record of success in Technical Recruiting supporting roles like Software Engineer, DevOps, Solutions Architect, etc.
  • Proven experience supporting US-based clients
  • Strong English (spoken + written)
  • Experience with high-volume recruiting environments
  • Experience working with VMS / MSP models
  • Highly process-driven and organized
  • Supporting customers in the US EST Timezone


Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting Government or strict compliance accounts
  • Recruiting experience for Retail Operations and/or Creative positions (Graphic Design, Fashion Design, etc.)
  • Metrics-driven mindset (submittals, interviews, placements)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

description:
Key Responsibilities:


  • Continuously monitor the target sector and provide insightful strategic analysis to EMIS clients through industry reports for Brazil and the Latin America region:
  • Research target industries - collect, analyse, interpret and present key industry information
  • Write in-depth industry analysis covering current conditions, performance, competitive landscape, major players, regulatory environment, segmentation, among others

  • Excellent command of English
  • Advanced skills in argumentative writing
  • Previous industry research experience


Conditions :


  • Freelance position
  • Attractive remuneration based on achieved results


How to apply:


If you are interested, please submit your CV and Cover Letter in English via email to with subject RA-BR.

All personal details will be kept strictly confidential and will be used only for the purposes of this recruitment.

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub!

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. O Que Você Vai Fazer

About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.
